android-patterns|Sign-in and account.summary: Plenix on Android signs people in, up and back in through the platform’s Credential Manager first (passkeys, saved passwords, Sign in with Google), and with a form when needed: OutlinedTextFields whose autofill types the platform understands (username, password, newPassword, smsOtpCode), a password field with a trailing Show toggle, one general error above the fields, and the primary button as wide as the form at the 48 dp target. The second step takes the code from the SMS Retriever or the user’s paste; a session about to end is an AlertDialog that keeps the work; each linked service is a list row with its status in words. On a compact window the form fills the screen under the top app bar; on medium and expanded windows it sits in a card a small dialog wide, as on the web.
